A '''reinforced battlegroup,''' or '''assault battlegroup,''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="ISB" />

==History==
The [[1st Tapani Assault Battlegroup]] was garrisoned in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ISB" />

==Organization==
A reinforced [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] was comprised of two [[line regiment]]s, an [[assault regiment]], an [[armor regiment]], and [[battlegroup headquarters]]. It included 14,890 personnel, 676 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], and 212 [[Tank|heavy tanks]]. The battlegroup was considered to the most versatile in the order of battle, with a mixture of both firepower and durability.<ref name="ISB" />

Reinforced battlegroups could be augmented by the addition of an [[artillery regiment]], two assault regiments, and a [[repulsorlift regiment]].<ref name="ISB2" />
